from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_lines = [i for i, row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    col_lines = [j for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and g[0][j] != bg]
    axis = 0 if row_lines else 1
    lines = row_lines if axis == 0 else col_lines
    n = h if axis == 0 else w
    bounds = [-1] + lines + [n]
    spans = [(bounds[k] + 1, bounds[k + 1]) for k in range(len(bounds)-1)]
    spans = [(a, b) for a, b in spans if a < b]
    if len(spans) < 2 or len({b-a for a,b in spans}) != 1:
        return g
    for offset in range(spans[0][1] - spans[0][0]):
        for pos in range(h if axis == 1 else w):
            coords = []
            vals = []
            for a, b in spans:
                ix = a + offset
                r, c = (pos, ix) if axis == 1 else (ix, pos)
                coords.append((r, c))
                if g[r][c] != bg:
                    vals.append(g[r][c])
            if not vals:
                continue
            value = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
            for r, c in coords:
                if g[r][c] == bg:
                    g[r][c] = value
    return g
